summary: This directory serves as the foundation for the application's core domain models and shared business logic, establishing the structural definitions and data entities required by higher-level modules to function consistently throughout the codebase.
responsibilities: Defining core domain entities and data structures
Centralizing shared business rules and constants
Providing consistent interfaces for data representation
Ensuring type safety for cross-module communication
relationships: Domain entities define the shape of data used by the business logic.
Shared interfaces enforce consistency across different application modules.
Business logic operations act upon the defined domain entities.
designDecisions: Strict type definitions for state consistency
Separation of data structure definitions from implementation logic
